title: OA-LAMA: An Outlier-Adaptive LLM Inference Accelerator with Memory-Aligned Mixed-Precision Group Quantization
problem: Activation outliers in quantized LLMs severely degrade accuracy; existing methods either misalign memory access or sacrifice quantization granularity due to non-uniform tensor distributions.
motivation: Efficient LLM inference deployment requires addressing the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff in low-precision quantization.
method: Hardware-software codesign with outlier-adaptive memory-aligned mixed-precision group (OAMAG) quantization format; outlier reordering maintains DRAM alignment; distribution-aware group allocation handles inter-layer variance; three-level accumulation architecture supports OAMAG efficiently.
key_novelty: Novel OAMAG format combining outlier reordering with memory-aligned access for mixed-precision group quantization.
contributions: Outlier-adaptive memory-aligned mixed-precision group format with reordering technique
Distribution-aware group allocation for inter-layer outlier variance
Hardware architecture with three-level accumulation and timing-balanced PEs
1.21-3.09x performance and 1.35-2.47x energy efficiency gains over leading accelerators

metrics.accuracy: Better accuracy than state-of-the-art 4-bit quantization methods

limitations: Focused on inference, not training; specific to quantized models; evaluation scope limited to tested LLM architectures.
